title: SSH traffic in ZIA: what is and is not inspected

steps.label: SSH payload inspection.
steps.text: {{no-ssh-inspection-article}} Why ZIA does not decrypt SSH is open {{gap:ssh-decryption-reason}}. File Type Control acts on files in HTTP, HTTPS and FTP flows ([[zia.file-type-control.criteria]]), not on SSH sessions.

steps.label: Gating.
steps.text: {{atp-ssh-tunneling}} A Firewall Filtering rule can match SSH as a network service ([[zia.firewall.network-services]], [[zia.firewall.criteria]]). How the service detects SSH and handles a CONNECT to port 22 is open {{gap:firewall-ssh-gating}}.

steps.label: Oversight.
steps.text: {{pra-ssh-consoles}} {{pra-session-recording}} For the product overview see the [[doc:references/zpa/privileged-remote-access.md]].

checks.do: Whether SSH payload inspection is expected from ZIA, since no ZIA help page documents it.

no-ssh-inspection-article.statement: No captured ZIA help page describes inspecting SSH payload. The only ZIA setting the captures tie to SSH is Advanced Threat Protection's SSH Tunneling option.

quotes: SSH Tunneling: Choose to Allow or Block. This refers to SSH traffic being tunneled over HTTP/S.

no-ssh-inspection-article.conditions: Rests on an absence. Search: `grep -rn -i -w ssh vendor/zscaler-help/*.md` returns SSH mentions only in ZPA, Privileged Remote Access, decoy, App Connector and appliance pages and in the ATP line cited; none in the ZIA Firewall, IPS Control, SSL Inspection, DLP or File Type Control pages. Other hits are the DNS Control record-type table (an SSHFP row, 'DNS type not mapped by ZS firewall') and the Zero Trust Browser, Zero Trust Branch (`ztb-`) and Cloud Connector (`cbc-`) pages, none of which describe ZIA SSH inspection. The captures are a subset of the help site.

atp-ssh-tunneling.statement: Advanced Threat Protection has an SSH Tunneling setting, Allow or Block, which applies to SSH traffic tunneled over HTTP/S. It is under Unauthorized Communication Protection, next to IRC Tunneling and Anonymizers.

quotes: SSH Tunneling: Choose to Allow or Block. This refers to SSH traffic being tunneled over HTTP/S.
IRC Tunneling: Choose to Allow or Block IRC traffic being tunneled over HTTP/S.

pra-ssh-consoles.statement: Privileged Remote Access reaches servers over RDP, SSH or VNC from a browser without Client Connector. A console is defined with a protocol and target host, and the Application Segment's privileged console protocol defaults to port 22 for SSH.

quotes: lets end users securely connect to servers, jump hosts, bastion hosts, or desktops using **RDP, SSH, or VNC**
Each console is defined with a protocol (RDP / SSH / VNC) and target host.
By default, port 5900 is entered for VNC and RealVNC, port 3389 is entered for RDP, and port 22 is entered for SSH.

pra-session-recording.statement: Privileged Remote Access records sessions; recordings are managed under Analytics > Privileged Sessions > Recordings and are gated by the Session Recording Full Access admin role permission.

quotes: Access to recordings is gated by the **Session Recording Full Access** admin role permission.

firewall-ssh-gating.title: How Firewall Filtering gates SSH
firewall-ssh-gating.detail: Unverified legacy statements: 'L4 firewall gating only. Firewall Filtering rules can allow/block SSH via network service (port 22) or custom ports', 'Zscaler identifies SSH by handshake signature in the first packet', and 'A proxy client making a CONNECT target:22 request can be allowed or blocked via Firewall Filtering rules.' SSH is a predefined network service identifier in the API (zia.firewall.network-services:tag-values), so a rule can name it; no source says how the service is detected (port or signature), or how a CONNECT to port 22 is treated. Resolves with a lab test and the Firewall service-detection documentation.
firewall-ssh-gating.blocks: advising how to allow or block SSH with Firewall Filtering

ssh-decryption-reason.title: Why ZIA does not decrypt SSH
ssh-decryption-reason.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'MITM'ing SSH would require control of both endpoints' keys ... ZIA doesn't implement SSH decryption.' The captures neither describe an SSH decryption feature nor explain its absence; the claim `no-ssh-inspection-article` records only that no inspection page was found. Resolves with a vendor statement.
ssh-decryption-reason.blocks: stating confidently that SSH decryption is impossible rather than undocumented
